symbols.name: SystemEndpoints
symbols.summary: Exposes diagnostic system endpoints for discovery, echo, runtime information, and registered modules.
symbols.remarks: The endpoint set maps routes under SystemEndpointsOptions.GroupPath when the options are enabled. Individual echo, info, and modules routes are controlled by their matching option flags. The info endpoint can hide machine, process, network, and runtime details when sensitive information should not be exposed. Example: services.AddEndpoints(new SystemEndpoints(new SystemEndpointsOptions { InfoEnabled = true, HideSensitiveInformation = true }));

symbols.name: Map(IEndpointRouteBuilder)
symbols.summary: Maps the enabled system routes into the supplied route builder.
symbols.remarks: The method returns without mapping routes when BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.EndpointsOptionsBase.Enabled is false. The root system route is always mapped when enabled; echo, info, and modules are mapped only when their corresponding option flags are enabled. Routes inherit the group configuration applied by BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.EndpointsBase.MapGroup(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder%2cBridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.EndpointsOptionsBase).

parameters.description: The route builder that receives the system endpoint mappings.

symbols.summary: Returns links to the enabled system endpoint routes for the current request host.
symbols.remarks: The response includes only links for routes enabled in the options. URLs are built from the request scheme, request host, and configured group path.

parameters.description: The current HTTP context used to build absolute endpoint URLs.

returns.description: An HTTP 200 result containing a dictionary of enabled system route names and URLs.

symbols.name: GetInfo(HttpContext, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Returns runtime, request, memory, configuration, custom metadata, and uptime information for the application.
symbols.remarks: The method collects process, runtime, operating system, memory, configuration, and uptime values. When BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpointsOptions.HideSensitiveInformation is enabled, machine, network, process, runtime, memory, and configuration details are returned as empty strings while custom metadata and uptime are still included. DNS lookup failures for host addresses are logged as warnings and represented as N/A. Unexpected collection failures are logged as errors and returned as problem details.

symbols.remarks: The response projects each supplied module into a new BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.SystemModule instance and does not expose additional module implementation details. Exceptions are logged and converted to problem details.
